summary: Elon Musk co-founded X.com in 1999, which merged with Confinity to form PayPal; he was replaced as CEO in 2000 but was its largest shareholder when eBay bought it. He founded SpaceX in 2002, became Tesla's chairman in 2004 and CEO in 2008, bought Twitter in 2022 (renamed X), and merged his AI company xAI into SpaceX in 2026 ahead of a record IPO. He spent at least $250 million backing Trump in 2024, led DOGE in 2025, then feuded publicly with Trump before returning to fund Republicans in the 2026 midterms.
